entry.summary:
Are you looking for a medical career that offers true work-life balance in one of the world's most stunning locations? Join Dr. Jenny as she explores her life as a General Practitioner (GP) in Wellington, the coastal capital of Aotearoa New Zealand.

From fulfilling work in refugee medicine to afternoon surf sessions, Jenny highlights the flexibility and professional satisfaction that comes with practicing medicine in the New Zealand healthcare system.

In this video, you’ll discover:

1. Meaningful Clinical Diversity: Jenny discusses her rewarding role at a not-for-profit clinic specializing in refugee medicine and her work in student health.

2. The GP Training Pathway: Gain insight into the three-year GP Education Programme, which balances formal seminars with supervised clinical practice.

3. A Supportive Work Culture: Hear why the New Zealand medical environment is more relaxed, making practitioners feel truly valued.

4. Unbeatable Lifestyle & Family Time: See how flexible hours allow Jenny to balance her career with raising a family and enjoying New Zealand's "great outdoors"—including surfing, swimming with dolphins, and coastal running.

5. Guidance for International Professionals: Jenny explains why the move is easier than you think and why you might just end up staying forever.

Why Practice General Practice in NZ?
Choosing a GP career in New Zealand means joining a system that prioritizes mental well-being and community connection. Whether you are drawn to the vibrant culture of Wellington or the flexible "choose your own hours" approach to medicine, New Zealand offers a lifestyle that is both fulfilling and sustainable.

Learn more about healthcare careers in New Zealand: https://info.health.nz/careers/roles/senior-medical-officers/general-practitioners-rural-hospital-doctors
